entries.german:
Wir Fridrich graf zu Kastel . Lantrichter zu Nurmberg . tun kunt an disem brief . daz für uns kom in gericht
Conrat Herrider von Winsheim vnd Haintz Wilde doselbst vnd clagten mit fürsprechn auf dez Mosparcz erb vnd
gut ze Freschendorf . darumb daz er sie versetzt het gen den Juden vnd sie nicht gelöst het daz sie schaden genomen
heten ze yeglicher vmb hundert phunt haller . daz antwurt mit fürsprechn der von Rosenberg hauskomentur
ze Virnsberg vnd jach die gut vnd erb daz er hört nennen daz wer sein vnd seins haus ze Virnsberch recht aygen vnd
zins[?] von in ze erb vnd die hernach geschribn person vnd leut heten vor irem gericht uf dieselbn gut ervolgt
vnd erclagt ze Virnsberch . er wölt auch daz bringe mit den gesworn scheppfen ze Virnsberch . daz dieselbn leut
auf die vorgeschribn gut die ersten clager weren vnd auch vor irem egenanten gericht ze Virnsberg daz hernach
geschribn gelt allez ervolgt vnd erclagt het . vnd bat vragen ain vrteil . ob er vnd sein haus vnd dieselbn hernach
geschribn person wolbillichn die vorndert auf den vorgeschribn gutn habn solte . vnd ir recht hubgelt gült
vnd schulde die er in schuldig wer vor auz darauf habn solten . da wider iahn Conrat Herrider vnd Haintz Wilde
man het nicht auf dieselbn gut erclagt . vnd sie heten die clag ee angriffn dann die leut alz der Comentuer
sprech die darauf erclagt solten habn . darumb ward erteilt daz der egenant Comentuer bringe solt mit den
gesworn scheppfen ze Virnsberg auf daz nehst Lantgericht daz werdn solt auf den Mitwochn vor Galli . ob die
hernach geschribn leut vnd clag auf dieselbn gut vor ir clag die sie vf dem Lantgericht auf die gut getan
heten erclagt heten zu Virnsberg . vnd waz vnd wie vil summ geltz yeder man dar auf erclagt hat . vnd darnach
solt geschehn waz recht wer . do da nu derselb gerichtz tag komen waz da kom vns für gericht . der egenant
von Rosenberg Comentuer zu Virnsberg vnd bracht mit zwain der gesworn scheppfen zu Virnsberg mit Friczen
Snayder von obern Altenbawr vnd mit Künczen Karl von Hegelbach die swurn beyde zu den heiligen vnd sagten auf
dieselbn ayde . daz die hernach geschribn person alle alz sie mit namen hernach geschribn sten in yeder solch summe
geltz alz auch an disem brief hernach beschribn vnd besundert ist ervolgt vnd erclagt heten uf dem gericht
zu Virnsberg auf dez vorgenanten Mosparcz erb vnd gut ze Freschendorf . alz recht ist . vnd namen dez ersten den wirt
ze Virnsberch . den müllner von obern Altenbawr vnd Conrat den Strauz von Pybert . daz die erclagt heten auf dez
egenanten Mosparcz zu sibn[?] vnd dreizzig phunt haller vnd den schadn . der Lokk von Andorf drew vnd achzig
phunt haller . vnd sechs vnd dreizzig phunt haller darumb derselb Lock vnd Hainrich[?] Strauz von Pybert sein purgen
worn . der wirt von nidern Altenbawr ain phunt haller . Haintz Klar fünf malter korn darumb er sein purg wer Wngelin
von Puch vnd der Weyerman von Pybert . drew vnd zweinczig phunt haller . darumb Conrat von Tachenbach vnd Hainrich
Schilher von Freschendorf purgen wern . der müllner von Freschendorf Hainrich Schilher vnd Fricz von Tachenbach acht
phunt . Herman Klar dreizzig phunt haller darumb er sein purg wer gen dem müllner von Stainbach vnd den schadn
Herman Klar fünfthalb phunt haller . darumb er sein purg wer gen dem Reyter vnd dem Luschn zu Tauerspach
der Schilher von Freschendorf an ainer[?] zweinczig phunt haller vnd sibenthalb phunt haller vnd den schadn da für
er sein purg wer achzehenthalb phunt haller die er dem Karbacher schuldig wer darumb purg wer Apel von
Merczbach vnd Hainrich Schilher von Freschendorf . der Schilher von Freschendorf . der müllner von Freschendorf
vnd Fricz von Tachenbach zehn phunt haller . darumb sie sein purgen weren . der Grünne von Tachenbach dreizzig
schilling haller vnd den Lokken[?] von Andorf zehn phunt haller darumb er sein purg wer vmb ein wisen
vnd do der egenant von Rosenberg Comentuer zu Virnsberg daz allez alz wol bracht het da bat er vragen ain vrteil
ob dieselbn clag alle die zu Virnsberg also erclagt heten wolbillichn vnd von rechtz wegn die vorndert mit der clag
auf dez egenanten Mosparcz gut habn solten . dasselb ward in mit gemeinr volg vnd vrteil erteilt […] so getaner
beschaidenheit daz der egenant Conrat Herrider vnd Haintz Wilde mit ir clag an dem Lantgericht […]
[…] mit dem […] die egenante gut vnd die übermazz waz dieselbn gut bezzer sind […]
die egenante person alle darauf zu Virnsberg erclagt habn . geben mit vrteil vnd dez Lantgerichts insigl
an Mitwochn vor Galli . nach gotes gepurt dreyzehenhundert iar vnd in dem sibenzigstem iar
entries.english: We, Friedrich Graf zu Kastel, Landrichter zu Nürnberg, make known by this letter: Konrad Herrider of Winsheim and Heinrich Wilde of the same place came before us in court and sued, through advocates, over the inheritance and goods of Mosparcz at Freschendorf, because he had pledged them to the Jews and had not redeemed them, so that they had suffered damage of one hundred pounds Heller each. The Hauskomtur von Rosenberg zu Virnsberg answered this through an advocate and stated that the goods and inheritance, as he had heard them named, were the rightful property of him and his house at Virnsberg and [?] held from them as hereditary tenure, and that the persons and people named below had already won judgment on these goods before his court and had sued there. He also wished to prove with the sworn Schöffen at Virnsberg that these people were the first plaintiffs on the aforementioned goods and had likewise sued for all the money named below before his said court at Virnsberg. He asked for a judgment whether he, his house and the persons named below should rightfully have precedence on the aforementioned goods for their lawful Hubgeld, Gült and the debts owed to them. Konrad Herrider and Heinrich Wilde objected that nothing had been sued on these goods before, and that they had begun their suit before the people whom the Komtur said had sued on them. Therefore it was adjudged that the said Komtur should prove with the sworn Schöffen at Virnsberg, at the next Landgericht, to be held on the Wednesday before St. Gall's day, whether the people and suit named below were prior to the suit which they had brought at the Landgericht on these goods and had sued at Virnsberg, and what and how much money each had sued for; and what is right should then be done. When that court day had come, the said von Rosenberg, Komtur zu Virnsberg, appeared before us in court and brought two of the sworn Schöffen at Virnsberg, Friedrich Snayder of Obern-Altenbawr and Kunz Karl of Hegelbach. They both swore on the saints and testified under that oath that the persons named below, as they are listed by name, had sued for and obtained judgment, each for the sum also written below and separately in this letter, in the court at Virnsberg on the inheritance and goods of the said Mosparcz at Freschendorf, as is lawful. They named first the innkeeper at Virnsberg, the miller of Obern-Altenbawr and Konrad the Strauz of Pybert, who had sued for thirty-seven [?] pounds Heller on the said Mosparcz's goods and for the damage. The Lokk of Andorf: eighty-three pounds Heller and thirty-six pounds Heller, for which the same Lock and Heinrich [?] Strauz of Pybert became his sureties. The innkeeper of Nieder-Altenbawr: one pound Heller. Heinz Klar: five Malter of grain, for which Wngelin of Puch was his surety, and the Weyerman of Pybert: twenty-three pounds Heller, for which Konrad of Tachenbach and Heinrich Schilher of Freschendorf became sureties. The miller of Freschendorf, Heinrich Schilher, and Friedrich of Tachenbach: eight pounds. Hermann Klar: thirty pounds Heller, for which he was surety to the miller of Stainbach, and for the damage. Hermann Klar: four and a half pounds Heller, for which he was surety to the Reyter and the Luschn of Tauerspach. The Schilher of Freschendorf: twenty pounds Heller and six and a half pounds Heller, and for the damage, for which he was surety for seventeen and a half pounds Heller which he owed the Karbacher, for which Apel of Merczbach and Heinrich Schilher of Freschendorf were sureties. The Schilher of Freschendorf, the miller of Freschendorf and Friedrich of Tachenbach: ten pounds Heller, for which they became his sureties. The Grünne of Tachenbach: thirty shillings Heller, and [the Lokk? [?]] of Andorf: ten pounds Heller, for which he was surety, concerning a meadow. When the said von Rosenberg, Komtur zu Virnsberg, had presented all this properly, he asked for a judgment whether all those who had sued thus at Virnsberg should rightfully and lawfully have precedence with their suit on the goods of the said Mosparcz. This was adjudged to them by common consent and judgment […] on such terms that the said Konrad Herrider and Heinrich Wilde, with their suit at the Landgericht […] […] the said goods and the surplus, by which these goods are worth more […] the said persons, who all sued on it at Virnsberg. Given with judgment and the seal of the Landgericht on the Wednesday before St. Gall's day, in the year thirteen hundred and in the seventieth year.

facts.content: answered through an advocate at the Landgericht the suit of Konrad Herrider and Heinrich Wilde over the goods of Mosparcz at Freschendorf, stating that others had already sued on these goods before his court at Virnsberg.
was ordered by judgment to prove at the next Landgericht, with the sworn Schöffen of Virnsberg, the earlier claims on the goods of Mosparcz at Freschendorf.

brought the sworn Schöffen Friedrich Snayder and Kunz Karl before the Landgericht and obtained judgment that those who had sued at Virnsberg on the goods of Mosparcz at Freschendorf had precedence over the suit of Konrad Herrider and Heinrich Wilde.
